deterministic_findings.headline: Critical application gravity shapes the AI agenda
deterministic_findings.body: 130 of the 140 displayed applications are Tier 1/Critical; AI use cases touching operations, crew, customer recovery or finance need dependency sequencing before they can be scaled responsibly.

deterministic_findings.headline: Hybrid hosting is real, not transitional noise
deterministic_findings.body: 47 displayed applications are on-premises; cloud and AI plans must respect latency, integration and resilience constraints rather than assuming direct platform replacement.

deterministic_findings.headline: AI usage is visible before AI value is claimable
deterministic_findings.body: The displayed AI tools carry $41,260,403 in estimated use cost, while Tower current claimable calculated value remains $0 in this local load.

evidence_gaps.gap: 13 AI adoption rows lack auditable business-outcome proof.
evidence_gaps.implication: Leadership can see deployment and usage, but cannot yet claim outcomes without Tower baselines and actuals.
